question: how many applications landed per outreach school when we match names even if written a bit differently, show every school including those with zero
gold_sql: WITH best AS (SELECT a."Applicant" AS applicant, o."School Name" AS matched_school, jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) AS sim FROM lpf_applications AS a JOIN lpf_outreach AS o ON jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) >= 0.9 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a."Applicant" ORDER BY sim DESC, o."School Name") = 1) SELECT o."School Name", COUNT(b.applicant) AS applications_received FROM lpf_outreach AS o LEFT JOIN best AS b ON b.matched_school = o."School Name" GROUP BY o."School Name" ORDER BY o."School Name"
